title: VM worker can dispatch duplicate conversation runs before backend events arrive
reasoning: dispatchAssignedRun only checks whether the run_id is already active, and it records the run/conversation mapping only after sendAutomatedQuery succeeds. During that gap the next heartbeat still reports ready when no active mapping exists and can accept another assigned_run for the same conversation_ref or a different run targeting the same conversation. This allows overlapping automated queries for the same conversation and ambiguous run event routing once mappings are later set.
reproduction: Have the heartbeat API return an assigned_run while sendAutomatedQuery is slow, then return another assigned_run with a different run_id but the same conversation_ref before the first call stores the mapping. Both automated queries can be dispatched.
recommendation: Reserve the run/conversation mapping before awaiting sendAutomatedQuery, and clear it on dispatch failure. Also reject assignments when either the run_id or conversation_ref is already active/pending.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No VM worker runtime tests are included, and there is no test evidence covering slow dispatch or duplicate heartbeat assignment races.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit test with a deferred sendAutomatedQuery and two assigned_run heartbeat responses for the same conversation_ref, asserting only one query dispatch occurs and the worker status becomes running while dispatch is pending.
minimumFixScope: frontend/src/main/vm_worker_runtime.cjs dispatch bookkeeping plus focused Jest coverage.
